subject.title: feat(macos): native-feel dashboard hosting — instant reopen, preload, frame autosave, ⌘N/⌘K, route memory

question: Should the macOS app adopt this combined preload/live-page reuse, persistent frame/route, and global native-shortcut behavior as the supported hybrid-shell experience once the two blockers and signed-app proof gap are resolved?
rationale: This is a broad user-visible macOS behavior change with persistent state and lifecycle implications, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an owner to confirm that the combined scope is the intended product direction.

options.title: Approve after fixes and proof
options.body: Keep the integrated feature, require both source fixes plus a redacted signed-app recording, then complete owner review.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only instant reopen and preload first, leaving persistent route/frame state and global shortcuts for separately proven follow-ups.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep current shipped dashboard hosting until maintainers define a smaller native-shell contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve after fixes and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the integrated feature, require both source fixes plus a redacted signed-app recording, then complete owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the repository's named project lead and the clearest owner of the proposed macOS hybrid-shell direction.
